integrity: The analytical equality and uniqueness arguments use the exact spin expansion, strict integer convexity, and circular-balance classification. The included independent rational spin-ensemble and exhaustive finite-layout computations are supporting checks, not a proof of infinite-size or all-size results.
scientific_limitations: Finite positive-temperature nearest-neighbor classical ferromagnetic Ising rings at zero field; two strictly positive, unequal bond strengths and fixed bond multiplicities. The susceptibility is the uniform-field linear response, not a dynamic or nonzero-field observable. The segregated layout is a comparison, not a claimed universal maximizer. Earlier general rearrangement results might subsume part of the conclusion.
title: Balanced bonds uniquely minimize zero-field susceptibility in a ferromagnetic Ising ring
